title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.14 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It consolidates exact chain-map and chain-homotopy calculations in one rational mapping-complex differential and makes primal or dual exact certificates independently replayable. Manifest artifact hashes now establish provenance only: gates, maturity, and promotion can change only when a registered exact replay recomputes the result. The closed polynomial profile derives one deterministic title and statement from its AST and grants no empirical, replication, scientific-truth, or deployment authority. Independently versioned protocol, theorem-kernel, and return-contract identities are bound by a strict component contract, while one verification spine removes duplicate CI without weakening clean-tag release checks. Release assets are built from exact tagged Git objects, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The protocol component remains byte-identical to 0.3.0-alpha.13, and the live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; indexed Knowledge bytes are NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
